name: Interior door pull handle
description: Handle gripped by hand to close the door from the inside. An ergonomic shape that calipers alone cannot describe, retained as the pilot of the phase 2 organic category, to be acquired by photogrammetry.

classification.intended_use: Closing the door from the inside, repeated manual loading

provenance.record_license: MIT for the record, geometry not yet produced

sources.title: 9xxteile - Porsche parts diagrams (PET exploded views)
sources.notes: Places the handle in the door subassembly. No usable dimension.

sources.title: 911uk - 993 interior plastics repair
sources.notes: Context on the fragility of the 993 interior plastics. No part named precisely in this thread.

titanium.galvanic_isolation: not applicable, polymer interior trim part

known_limits: Classed functional and not non_critical: the part takes a repeated manual load and its failure in the hand can cause injury.
No acquisition done; the photogrammetry will need to carry a scale reference.
Mounting interfaces and tightening torque unknown.
Fatigue behavior of a printed polymer not evaluated.
